unit_note: Every figure here is rupees in LAKH. The Annual Plan prints its earlier columns in lakh and its Budget Estimate 2026-27 column in THOUSANDS, both labelled in the same header block, on 333 of its 491 table pages. The unit is decided per page from that page's own header and normalised here.
